verdictScope: Independent scoped TLS code review only; this is not completion of the entire review pipeline or cross-desktop runtime acceptance.
intent: Avoid OpenSSL3.5 hybrid predicted-keyshare compatibility failures in the isolated S3 transport without replacing an explicitly configured Groups/Curves policy, weakening certificate verification, adding request replay, or linking the AWS SDK into the resident.
residual_risks: The exact network/firewall cause of the original curl35 failures is not established by static review; this receipt supports the bounded compatibility implementation, not a claimed root cause.
Future OpenSSL major versions are allowed by the >=3.5 check; current default-group semantics and unusual custom library-context policies require their own runtime support evidence.
testing_gaps: No new builds, tests, network requests, allocation-failure injection or guest interactions were performed during sibling scored windows. Backend/policy tests were reviewed, not re-executed by this review.

Per-handle setopt allocation failure and fallback reset are not directly fault-injected in test_sdk_contract; their current nonthrowing path is small and the secure-default fallback is explicitly reviewed.

coverage.callerOverride: Parent explicitly requested one independent bounded leaf read with no additional agents/external model review and artifacts in its private root. Full skill dispatch/merge/validator and source artifact writes were not performed.
criteria: AGENTS.md user instructions: provider-neutral boundaries, dynamic distro Qt, no credential material, immutable tested source
checked: Strict exact OpenSSL backend/version parser and curl7.73 compile/runtime guards; unsupported or missing configuration disables the change.
Own temporary CURL probe is cleaned by RAII before request handles/headers; its result only enables a later supported hook.

OpenSSL CONF objects and allocated default path have bounded RAII/free ownership. Pre-existing thread-local error queue disables override without clearing it; inspection-generated errors clear at scope exit. Successful optional ENOENT is accepted; other warnings/read/section failures fail closed.
Groups/Curves case aliases, numeric command prefixes, SSL module suffix/prefix aliases, includes/variable resolution are covered; policy values never leave the process.

Pooled-handle hook is noexcept and uses no throwing allocation; fallback resets only group selection, not certificate checks. Original DELETE fresh-connect/no-reuse and thread-local request scope are untouched.

Local pinned AWS SDK a9f0ffcc276664b475230206fa554841ad5bc3de CurlHttpClient implementation acquires handle/headers before hook, performs certificate verification setup before hook, and releases/destroys after perform; explains avoiding hook throws.

CMake sources/definitions/linkage attach compatibility and Crypto only to S3 runtime/module and tests. Actual current dev resident link rule has no AWS SDK/S3 runtime/Curl/Crypto linkage; provider facade remains unchanged. Contract fingerprint includes new helper files and OpenSSL discovery/version.
notAssessed: GNOME/KDE live gates currently owned by siblings
